metadata.title: Explicit Transgression Primitives on Flag Manifolds
metadata.abstract: Borel's theorem presents the flag manifold cohomology as the coinvariant algebra $H^*(K/T; \mathbb{C}) \cong S(\mathfrak{h}^\vee)/I_W$, establishing the vanishing of characteristic forms $p_j(F_\mathfrak{t}) = \mathrm{tr}(F_\mathfrak{t}^j)$ non-constructively; projection from the Weil algebra $W(\mathfrak{k})$ yields closed primitives on $K$ failing to descend. We construct relative transgression primitives $\alpha_j \in (\Lambda^{2j-1}\mathfrak{m}^\vee)^T \cong {}^K\Omega^{2j-1}(K/T)$ satisfying $d_\mathfrak{m} \alpha_j = -p_j(F_\mathfrak{t})$ on $K/T$. Via connections $\theta_s = \theta_\mathfrak{t} + s\theta_\mathfrak{m}$, the curvature factors as $F_s = (1-s)(F_\mathfrak{t} - s\theta_\mathfrak{m}^2)$; expanding via non-commutative word sums and Euler's Beta integral yields a universal closed formula for all $j \ge 1$. These primitives exhibit a structural transition: $\alpha_2 = -\frac{1}{3}\mathrm{tr}(\theta_\mathfrak{m}^3)$ is curvature-free, $\alpha_3$ is linear in $F_\mathfrak{t}$, while at $j = 4$, $[F_\mathfrak{t}, \theta_\mathfrak{m}^2] \neq 0$ shatters cyclic trace symmetry into independent necklaces, producing the irreducible invariant $\mathrm{tr}(\theta_\mathfrak{m} \wedge F_\mathfrak{t} \wedge \theta_\mathfrak{m}^2 \wedge F_\mathfrak{t})$. On the $A_2$ root lattice ($\mathfrak{sl}_3(\mathbb{C})$), $T$-invariant cochains correspond to closed loops, $\alpha_2 = \Omega_- - \Omega_+$ is the oriented difference of triangles, and $d_\mathfrak{m}$ acts as an edge-fracturing operator witnessing the exactness of $c_2(E)$. While character theory encounters a multiplicity barrier at $k=4$ in Specht decompositions, a minimal Koszul DGA resolution $K_\bullet(p_2, \dots, p_k)$ resolves the coinvariant algebra, recovering the Poincaré polynomial $P_{K/T}(t) = \prod_{j=2}^k \frac{1-t^{2j}}{1-t^2}$ and Euler characteristic $\chi(K/T) = k!$ without matrix-rank ambiguities.
